scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan.bold,magenta.bold --kill-others-on-fail "bun run dev:backend" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: bunx --bun varlock run -- cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: bun run lint:frontend && bun run lint:backend
scripts.format: bun run format:frontend && bun run format:backend
scripts.format:check: bun run format:check:frontend && bun run format:check:backend
scripts.test:backend: bunx --bun varlock run -- cargo test --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml
scripts.migrate: bunx --bun varlock run -- cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -- migrate
scripts.create-user: bunx --bun varlock run -- cargo run --manifest-path backend/Cargo.toml -- create-user
